summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on August 21, 2026, two remaining 8% unsecured OID February Debentures totaling $543,478.26 in principal were assigned by Cecilia Castro, Harding Castro and 622 Capital LLC to a third-party assignee for cash equal to par, then settled in full via issuance of common stock to the assignee. This follows prior debt-for-equity extinguishments (32,909 and 33,968 shares), with remaining maturities extended to October 31, 2026 and the July Note conversion price reset to $8.00. Watch dilution and overhang, note terms, and further conversions.
